pages.title: Field Notes
pages.text: $(bold)Dr. Vasik's field notes describe early Acheronite handling teams improvising climbing gear from crystal fragments.$()$(br2)Three teams lost fingers before someone thought to add leather grips. ORSA classified the design, then lost the file.$(br2)The surviving version bites into frozen surfaces hard enough to drag you up a wall if your arms can still listen.

pages.title: Use Notes
pages.text: Wear them in a Curios $(thing)hands$() slot to climb tagged frozen surfaces: snow blocks, ice, packed ice, blue ice, frozen obsidian, frozen dirt, and frozen sand.$(br2)Hold $(thing)Jump$() against the wall to climb, hold $(thing)Sneak$() to stay put, and let go to drop. Hollows still win any argument about movement priority.
Acheronite shards, iron, leather, and the confidence to use crystal knives as handholds.
